mapper.sql: h.host_id, h.host_name, h.ip, h.ssh_port, h.ssh_protocol, h.username, h.auth_type, h.password_cipher, h.private_key_cipher, h.dept_id, h.status, h.last_test_at, h.last_test_msg, h.remark, h.create_by, h.create_time, h.update_by, h.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_host h WHERE h.host_id = #{hostId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_host(host_name, ip, ssh_port, ssh_protocol, username, auth_type, password_cipher, private_key_cipher, dept_id, status, remark, create_by, create_time) VALUES(#{hostName}, #{ip}, #{sshPort}, #{sshProtocol}, #{username}, #{authType}, #{passwordCipher}, #{privateKeyCipher}, #{deptId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_host WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND host_name = #{hostName}
SELECT FROM ai_host h WHERE h.host_name = #{hostName} LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT h.host_id FROM ai_host h INNER JOIN ai_session s ON FIND_IN_SET(h.host_id, s.active_host_ids) > 0 WHERE s.last_active_at > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) AND h.host_id IN #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_host WHERE host_id IN #{id}
